summary: CME Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment (Amendment No. 11) to its existing 364-day multi-currency revolving secured credit facility with Bank of America as Administrative Agent and Citibank as Collateral Agent. The facility remains at $7 billion (expandable to $10 billion) and is used solely for clearing-house liquidity support, collateralized by clearing firm guaranty fund contributions and performance bond assets. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring—is present. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation.
